input.claim: We build Thalon in the open and share every step of the work publicly.
sources:
TENANT IDENTITY (operator-asserted):
COMPANY: Thalon
FACTS: One prompt fans out into platform-native drafts written in your brand voice. Every draft passes two judge gates before a person sees it: a brand-safety denylist and a grounding check against facts the operator provided. Every draft lands in an approve queue that shows its judge verdicts. Nothing publishes without explicit human approval, given per platform, every time. Operator corrections become recorded evaluation cases that harden the judges.
TOPICS: content automation, building in public, AI safety gates and human approval
